benefits_retirement_contribution_010.answer: District contributes to STRS as if the teachers were full-time.
benefits_retirement_contribution_010.evidence: Participating teachers and the District shall contribute to STRS as if the teachers were full-time.

benefits_retiree_012.evidence: Employees hired before July 1, 2004... require 7-12 consecutive years; those hired on or after July 1, 2004, require 20 consecutive years for paid retiree health benefits.
